newsitem.title: UK: Single Brent date kept from chains - trade.
newsitem.headline: Single Brent date kept from chains - trade.

text.p: The only Brent cargo nominated loading dates of June 26-28 on Wednesday was kept from the paper chains ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
They said the cargo was kept by Glencore. The equity holder was Shell.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
